Pantry.Title: Pantry
Pantry.Hint: Click or drag ingredients into the pot. Ingredients from the sidebar or a compendium also work and aren't used up.
Pantry.Empty: Nobody is carrying any ingredients. Hunt some beasts or gather blooms!
Pantry.NoParty: No active party, so all player characters are shown.

Pot.Title: The Pot
Pot.OneDie: A single die can't match. This meal would be done immediately with a rating of 0.

Recipe.Title: Recipe card
Recipe.Name: Dish name
Recipe.DescriptionPlaceholder: How do you prepare it? What does it smell like?
Recipe.Familiar: Familiar flavor! This matches "{name}" in your cookbook.
Recipe.FamiliarTokens: +{n} tokens you can discard instead of a die.

Cook.AutoHint: Roll until done, discarding automatically (tokens first, then the biggest die).
Cook.Pick: No matches! Pick a die to discard, then roll again.

Serve.Title: Serve the feast
Serve.Hint: Every diner gets the full Meal Rating to split between clearing Hit Points, clearing Stress and gaining Hope.
Serve.NoDiners: Nobody is eating. Go back and pick diners next time.
Serve.Spicy: Spicy! A set matched on 8 or higher, so this dish can't clear Stress.
Serve.Risky: Risky: no matches! Every diner clears all Hit Points and Stress and gains 3 Hope.
Serve.Death: Risky: the dice matched. The Meal Rating is 0 and every diner must make a death move.
Serve.Speed: Built for Speed: every diner gets +1 Agility until their next short rest.

Cookbook.Title: The party cookbook
Cookbook.Empty: No recipes yet. Your first feast will be written here.
Cookbook.DeleteBody: Remove this recipe from the cookbook?
Cookbook.Hint: Cooking a dish with the same flavor profile as a recipe in here adds tokens equal to the party's tier.
Cookbook.CookAgainHint: Put the same ingredients in the pot. Familiar flavor gives tokens!

lastDrop.name: Last Drop
lastDrop.hint: When one die remains, roll it and add it to the Meal Rating.
lastDrop.rolled: Last Drop! The final die adds {value} to the Meal Rating.

risky.name: Risky
risky.hint: No matches at all: clear all HP and Stress, gain 3 Hope. Any match: Meal Rating 0 and a death move.

spicy.name: Spicy
spicy.hint: If dice match on 8 or higher, this dish can't clear Stress.

builtForSpeed.name: Built for Speed
builtForSpeed.hint: +1 Agility until your next short rest.

Confirm.Title: Into the pot?
Confirm.Body: These ingredients will be removed from inventories:
Confirm.Nothing: None. Everything in the pot came from outside anyone's inventory.

Abandon.Title: Abandon the meal?
Abandon.Body: The ingredients are already used. Abandoning throws the meal away.

Errors.NoGM: A GM needs to be online to cook with other characters' ingredients.
Errors.Timeout: The GM didn't respond in time.

Forge.Title: Ingredient Generator
Forge.Heading: Forge
Forge.DropBeast: Drag an adversary here, or pick one below.
Forge.HPGuide: Max HP sets the harvest: 4 or less → 1, 5–7 → 2, 8–10 → 3, 12+ → 4. Stronger beasts lean toward bigger dice.
Forge.BloomHint: Once per rest, a PC can spend a Hope to gather a bloom: roll their Hope Die (d12) for its flavor.
Forge.CustomHint: Start from a blank ingredient and set every flavor yourself.
Forge.NoDrafts: Harvested and gathered ingredients land here. Tweak them, then save them to the larder or hand them out.
Forge.MaxFlavors: An ingredient has at most 3 flavors.

Larder.Name: Beast Feast Larder
Larder.Title: Larder
Larder.NotCreated: The larder is created when you save your first ingredient.
Larder.OpenItem: Open item sheet (drag onto any sheet to give)
Larder.Empty: The larder is empty. Harvest a beast or gather a bloom!
Larder.DeleteBody: Remove {name} from the larder? Copies already given out stay where they are.

Live.Broadcasting: Everyone at the table is watching this feast.
Live.GatherHint: Opens the kitchen for every player so they can watch you cook live.
Live.Gathered: The party gathers around the pot.
Live.TheirMove: {name} is at the stove. Watch the pot!
Live.YourShare: {name} is plating up. You can adjust your own character's share.

LarderStorage.Name: Larder storage
LarderStorage.Hint: Where the Ingredient Generator keeps saved ingredients.

Theme.Name: Kitchen theme
Theme.Hint: Color theme from the Core Rulebook sheet themes. Auto follows the party sheet's theme.

DiceSoNice.Name: Roll flavor dice in 3D
DiceSoNice.Hint: Use Dice So Nice (if active) for flavor dice, colored by flavor.

BeastFeastGear.Name: Beast Feast equipment
BeastFeastGear.Hint: The compendium browser starts filtered to Beast Feast items (clear the Campaign Frame filter to see everything), and character creation suggests Beast Feast starting gear instead of the standard class gear.
